explanation.headline: Lactulose is not on FDA's shortage list; Corvale General has 23.4 days on hand and Corvale Lakeside has 19.1 days on hand

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include lactulose as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale General holds 222 eachs of lactulose 10 g/15 mL 30 mL with 9.5 used per day, giving 23.4 days on hand.
Corvale Lakeside holds 35 eachs of the same presentation with 1.8 used per day, giving 19.1 days on hand.
The product label for NDC 00116400511 names Xttrium Laboratories, Inc. as the registered manufacturing plant (FEI 3008436464).
FDA inspected that plant on 2025-06-18 and classified it OAI, with the classification known on 2025-09-16.

Buyer should verify current supply from APOZEAL PHARMACEUTICALS INC., Actavis Pharma, Inc., and Atlantic Biologicals Corp., none of which are on the shortage list and none of which have a placed plant on their labels.

rejected.text: A subsequent inspection on 2026-06-16 resulted in a VAI classification known on 2026-08-24.
rejected.reason: causal claim ("resulted in") that the cited record does not make

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
